title: The Depth of a Prediction: Where Language Models Resolve a Word Predicts Human Reading Time
abstract: arXiv:2611.25970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surprisal from a language model's final layer predicts how long people read a word, yet the model computes its prediction across many layers. We read each word's prediction at every layer with the tuned lens and summarize this layerwise surprisal trajectory by its resolution depth, the depth around which its change is centered. On eight English eye-tracking and self-paced reading corpora (81,957 words) and ten GPT-2, OPT and Pythia models, words that a model resolves later, and the words after them, are read more slowly than equally surprising words. Resolution depth improves held-out prediction beyond final-layer surprisal, entropy and the best single layer by 0.26 millinats per word (pooled p = 0.001), about a third of entropy's gain, and each model family gains, GPT-2 and Pythia through one corpus each. translated_title: 预测的深度：语言模型解析词语的层级位置可预测人类阅读时间
translated_abstract: 来自语言模型最后一层的意外度预测了人们阅读一个词的时长，然而模型是在许多层中逐步计算这一预测的。我们使用调谐透镜在每一层读取每个词的预测，并用“解析深度”来概括这条逐层意外度轨迹——即其变化所围绕的中心深度。在八个英语眼动追踪和自定步速阅读语料库（81,957 个词）以及十个 GPT-2、OPT 和 Pythia 模型上，模型解析较晚的词，以及这些词之后的词，与同等意外程度的词相比被阅读得更慢。在留出集预测上，解析深度在最终层意外度、熵以及最佳单层之外额外提升了每词 0.26 毫奈特的预测能力（合并 p = 0.001），约为熵所带来的增益的三分之一，且每个模型家族均有所获益，其中 GPT-2 和 Pythia 各通过一个语料库体现。净增益在不同语料库之间存在差异（随机效应均值 0.07，p = 0.37）；相对于层序打乱的解析深度——其引入了同样多的系数……
tldr: 论文提出“解析深度”这一新指标，用以衡量语言模型在哪一层完成对一个词的预测，并证明模型解析越晚的词及其后续词会被人类读得更慢，且解析深度能在最终层意外度和熵之外显著提升对人类阅读时间的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "resolution depth"—the layer at which a language model resolves a word's prediction—and shows that later-resolved words and the words after them are read more slowly by humans, with resolution depth significantly improving predictions of human reading time beyond final-layer surprisal and entropy.
